faqs.question: What daycare options are available for a 3-year-old in Espoo?
faqs.answer: Check municipal and private daycare centers; some offer English support.

faqs.question: Are there free daycare options in Espoo?
faqs.answer: Yes, government-owned kindergartens offer free services for eligible children.

faqs.question: Can my child attend daycare if they only speak Chinese?
faqs.answer: Some centers offer language support; contact them for details.

faqs.question: How do I apply for daycare in Espoo?
faqs.answer: Contact your municipality's early childhood education office or apply online through espoo.fi.

faqs.question: Do daycare centers provide meals?
faqs.answer: Many daycare centers include meals as part of their services.

faqs.question: Are there English-speaking daycare options in Espoo?
faqs.answer: Some centers offer English; check specific locations for availability.

faqs.question: What is the cost of daycare in Espoo?
faqs.answer: Government-run centers are free; private options vary in cost.

faqs.question: When can my child start daycare in Finland?
faqs.answer: Children can start daycare at age 3, before formal schooling begins at age 7.

faqs.question: How do I find daycare near my workplace?
faqs.answer: Search for centers in Central Espoo on the espoo.fi website or contact the local municipality.

faqs.question: What should I look for in a daycare center?
faqs.answer: Check for meals, language support, availability during work hours, and proximity to your workplace.
